Goal: even shaft effort near sustainable_shaft_power (~155 W pod) after the start settles; spend what is left of the reserve in the last ~800 m (finish cue ~700 m to go). Check critical power from heart rate: at steady effort HR levels off below CP, keeps climbing above. If HR flat at ~155 W by min 10-12, consider a test piece / small push. Watch for incidents: weed (speed drops vs pod power -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod vs HR/speed disagree), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell).

Plan: measure HR trend over ~race_s 520-650 (late in the piece, before turn ~655). Model: slope ~ k*(P-CP); if slope at ~147 W is only slightly negative (~-0.3..-0.5) CP~150 (pod calibration right, so 160 W too hard); if strongly negative (<-1.5) CP is near 158-160. HR kinetics bias the late slope down by ~0.3.
